title: Home Insurance Policy (Building and Contents)
summary: Cover for your flat B-602, Sahyadri Heights, Baner (building ₹65,00,000, contents ₹8,00,000), with earthquake and portable electronics add-ons.

clauses.title: Property insured
clauses.text: This policy covers the building of the flat at B-602, Sahyadri Heights, Baner, Pune 411045, including its fixtures and fittings and the insured's proportionate share of common areas, for a sum insured of ₹65,00,000, and the household contents kept in the flat, such as furniture, appliances, clothing and kitchen items, for a sum insured of ₹8,00,000.
clauses.plain: Your flat's structure is covered for ₹65,00,000 and the things inside for ₹8,00,000.

clauses.title: Basis of settlement
clauses.text: Loss of or damage to the building will be settled on the cost of repairing or rebuilding it to a condition substantially the same as, but not better than, when new. Loss of or damage to contents will be settled on the cost of repair, or of replacement by an item of the same kind and capacity, less an allowance for wear and tear for items more than five years old.
clauses.plain: We pay to repair or rebuild the flat, and to repair or replace your things, with a cut for wear on items over five years old.

clauses.title: Period of insurance
clauses.text: This policy is in force from 15 January 2026 to 14 January 2027, both days inclusive.
clauses.plain: You are covered from 15 January 2026 to 14 January 2027.

clauses.title: Occupancy
clauses.text: The insured property is declared as a self-occupied residential flat. Cover applies only while it is used as a private dwelling. Any change in occupancy, such as letting it out or using it for business, must be notified to the Company in writing.
clauses.plain: The cover assumes you live in the flat; tell us if you rent it out or use it for business.

clauses.title: Fire
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building and contents caused by fire, including fire caused by an electrical short circuit, and by explosion or implosion of domestic appliances such as gas cylinders. Damage caused by water or chemicals used to put out the fire is also covered.
clauses.plain: Damage from fire, including a short circuit or a cylinder blast, is covered.

clauses.title: Lightning
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building and contents caused by lightning, including damage to wiring and appliances caused by a power surge resulting directly from a lightning strike.
clauses.plain: Damage from lightning, including appliances fried by a lightning surge, is covered.

clauses.title: Storm, cyclone and flood
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building and contents caused by storm, cyclone, typhoon, tempest, hurricane, tornado, flood or inundation, including water entering the flat through a window or door broken by the storm.
clauses.plain: Damage from storms, cyclones or flooding is covered.

clauses.title: Bursting of water tanks and pipes
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building and contents caused by bursting or overflowing of water tanks, apparatus or pipes, including damage to the flat caused by water from a neighbouring flat. The cost of repairing the burst tank or pipe itself is not covered.
clauses.plain: Water damage from a burst pipe or overflowing tank, even from the flat above, is covered.

clauses.title: Burglary and housebreaking
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to contents caused by burglary or housebreaking, and against damage to the building caused in the course of such an act, provided there is visible evidence of forcible and violent entry into or exit from the flat. The police must be informed within 24 hours as set out in Clause 7.1.
clauses.plain: Theft after someone breaks into your flat is covered; there must be signs of forced entry.

clauses.title: Riot, strike, malicious damage and impact
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building and contents caused by riot, strike, malicious damage or terrorism, and by impact from any vehicle, falling trees or aircraft.
clauses.plain: Damage from riots, vandalism, or a vehicle or tree crashing into the building is covered.

clauses.title: Landslide and subsidence
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building caused by landslide, rockslide or subsidence of the land on which the building stands. Damage from settlement of new structures, normal shrinkage or faulty construction is not covered.
clauses.plain: Damage from a landslide or the ground sinking is covered, but not cracks from poor construction.

clauses.title: Earthquake
clauses.text: In consideration of the additional premium paid, the Company will indemnify the insured against loss of or damage to the building and contents caused by earthquake, volcanic eruption or other convulsions of nature, including resulting fire and shock.
clauses.plain: Earthquake damage to your flat and belongings is covered.

clauses.title: Portable electronics
clauses.text: In consideration of the additional premium paid, the Company will indemnify the insured against accidental loss of or damage to portable electronic equipment, such as laptops, mobile phones, tablets and cameras, anywhere in India, up to ₹1,50,000 in total during the policy period. Items must be less than five years old and supported by a purchase invoice. Mechanical or electrical breakdown, and loss of items left unattended in a public place, are not covered.
clauses.plain: If your laptop or phone is accidentally damaged or lost anywhere in India, it is covered up to ₹1,50,000.

clauses.title: Jewellery and valuables: not opted
clauses.text: The jewellery and valuables add-on has not been opted under this policy. Jewellery, gold, silver, precious stones, watches, works of art and collections are not covered against any peril, whether kept in the flat or elsewhere.
clauses.plain: Jewellery and gold are not covered, because the valuables add-on was not taken.

clauses.title: Loss of rent: not opted
clauses.text: The loss of rent add-on has not been opted under this policy. Rent lost, or the cost of alternative accommodation, while the flat is being repaired after insured damage is not covered.
clauses.plain: Rent you lose or pay elsewhere while the flat is repaired is not covered.

clauses.title: Public liability: not opted
clauses.text: The public liability add-on has not been opted under this policy. Legal liability for injury to other people or damage to their property arising from the flat, such as water leaking into the flat below, is not covered.
clauses.plain: If damage from your flat harms a neighbour or their property, your liability is not covered.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: Each and every claim under this policy is subject to a deductible of ₹5,000, which is borne by the insured.
clauses.plain: You pay the first ₹5,000 of every claim.

clauses.title: Under-insurance
clauses.text: If at the time of loss the sum insured for the building or for the contents is less than the cost of rebuilding the building or replacing the contents, the Company will pay only that proportion of the loss which the sum insured bears to that cost. This condition does not apply where the shortfall is 15% or less.
clauses.plain: If your cover is too low for the real value, claims are reduced in the same proportion.

clauses.title: Theft without forced entry
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for theft of contents unless it involves forcible and violent entry into or exit from the flat. Theft by a member of the household or by domestic staff, loss found only at stock-taking, and items that are simply missing are not covered.
clauses.plain: If things go missing with no sign of a break-in, including theft by household staff, it is not covered.

clauses.title: Wear and tear and gradual deterioration
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for wear and tear, gradual deterioration, rust, damp, seepage or leakage occurring over time, rot, insects, termites or vermin, or for routine maintenance.
clauses.plain: Normal wear, slow leaks, damp and termites are not covered.

clauses.title: Electrical and mechanical breakdown
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for mechanical or electrical breakdown or derangement of appliances and electronic equipment, including portable electronics, unless the breakdown results from an insured peril such as fire or lightning. Accidental external damage to portable electronics is covered under Clause 3.2.
clauses.plain: An appliance or laptop that simply stops working is not covered; accidental damage to portable electronics is.

clauses.title: Cash, documents and certain property
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for loss of cash, currency notes, bullion, cheques, securities, documents, title deeds, or for loss of data or software, or for vehicles and their accessories.
clauses.plain: Cash, documents, data and vehicles are not covered under this policy.

clauses.title: Deliberate and construction-related loss
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for loss caused intentionally by the insured, or for damage resulting from faulty design, workmanship or materials, or from structural alterations, renovation or repair work.
clauses.plain: Damage you cause on purpose, or from poor construction or renovation work, is not covered.

clauses.title: War and nuclear risks
clauses.text: The Company shall not be liable for loss directly or indirectly caused by war, invasion, hostilities, civil war, rebellion, or nuclear weapons material, ionising radiation or radioactive contamination.
clauses.plain: Loss caused by war or nuclear events is not covered.

clauses.title: Unoccupied property
clauses.text: If the flat is left unoccupied for more than 60 consecutive days, cover for burglary, malicious damage and bursting of water tanks and pipes is suspended for the period beyond 60 days, unless the insured has informed the Company in advance and the Company has agreed in writing to continue the cover.
clauses.plain: If the flat is empty for more than 60 days in a row, burglary and pipe-burst cover stops unless you tell us first.

clauses.title: Reasonable care
clauses.text: The insured shall take all reasonable precautions to protect the property, keep it in good repair, lock doors and windows when the flat is unattended, and comply with fire safety rules applicable to the building.
clauses.plain: Look after the flat and lock up when you go out.

clauses.title: Alterations and change in risk
clauses.text: The insured shall inform the Company in writing of any material change in the risk, including structural alterations, a change in the use of the flat, or the storage of hazardous goods. Cover for the changed risk will apply only once the Company has accepted it.
clauses.plain: Tell us before major renovations or any change in how the flat is used.

clauses.title: Claim intimation
clauses.text: The insured shall notify the Company within 7 days of any loss or damage, through the claims helpline or the website. In the case of burglary, housebreaking, riot or malicious damage, the police must be informed within 24 hours and a copy of the FIR provided. The insured shall take all practicable steps to reduce further loss.
clauses.plain: Tell us within 7 days; for a burglary, also tell the police within 24 hours.

clauses.title: Documents and survey
clauses.text: A claim must be supported by the claim form, photographs of the damage, purchase invoices or other proof of ownership and value of contents, repair estimates, the FIR where applicable, and a fire brigade report for a fire claim. The Company may appoint a surveyor, and the insured shall not dispose of damaged items until the surveyor has inspected them.
clauses.plain: Keep photos, bills and estimates, and do not throw away damaged items until our surveyor sees them.

clauses.title: Settlement
clauses.text: The Company will settle the claim within 30 days of receiving the surveyor's final report, by payment to the insured's bank account on file or, at its option, by repair or replacement. Where the flat is mortgaged, payment for the building will be made with the consent of the lender named in the Schedule, if any.
clauses.plain: We settle within 30 days of the surveyor's final report.
